boundaries.api: Preparation has no transport and cannot load credentials. Inherited batch adapter requires literal enablement and workspace enrollment.
boundaries.commands: prepare/preview select one immutable ID and reject live/report arguments; inherited batch flush refuses --event-id.
boundaries.discovery: No native runtime menu, slash-command or tool registration changed; scope audit pins read-only native baseline.
boundaries.jobs: No new scheduler; existing tick only invokes live adapter on literal enabled true. This worker does not install services.
boundaries.migrations: No live source or queue migration. PF-76 historical records held without rewriting IDs, payloads or delivery metadata.
boundaries.resume: Disabled restart retains queue and does not load credentials or send; previews preserve status/attempt/backoff metadata.
boundaries.tools: Internal standalone Python tooling only; no agent tool registration or execution API added.

internal_boundary: Explicit internal Python commands; no runtime registration or native UI changes. Preparation never sends. Inherited live adapter requires explicit enablement and enrollment; operator authority remains separate.
